data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 52,922k (2014: GBP 34,490k) in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end.

prior_year_events.impact_description: favourable claims experience for the year with no significant losses, in contrast to 2014 where 3 significant airline losses affected the Syndicate.

named_events.loss_description: small net exposure to the flooding caused by the UK storms in December.
The UK Property claims ratio has also been impacted by the UK Floods during December.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3210 reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 32.926 million in 2015, primarily driven by favorable claims development across most business units, particularly Marine and Aviation. This was supported by low catastrophe activity and the absence of significant large losses, contrasting with 2014 which saw three major airline losses. The Syndicate's prudent reserving philosophy, which recognizes adverse experience immediately but takes credit for favorable experience only when certainty is achieved, also contributed to the releases. The release impacted underwriting years 2011, 2012, and 2013. Property and Commercial business units did not benefit from these prior year reserve improvements.
raw_causal_phrases: Syndicate's reserving philosophy of fully recognising any adverse experience immediately but only taking credit for favourable experience when enough time has passed to give certainty
low 2015 claims, particularly in the Cargo and Specie segments, and favourable development of prior year reserves
favourable claims experience for the year with no significant losses, in contrast to 2014 where 3 significant airline losses affected the Syndicate

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle as the narrative explicitly states a 'net' release. The narrative states a net release of GBP 52.922m, while the gross calculation from the triangle is a release of GBP 32.926m. The gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions.
